symptom: `Visible: $currentObject/ChangedDate != empty` on an entity declaring `ChangedDate: AutoChangedDate` passed check and exec; mx check reported CE0117. The same declared name in contentparams built.
cause: A pseudo-type declares the system member, not an attribute of that name. Attribute paths map the declared name (storedSystemMemberName) but expressions are written verbatim, and no page check looks at the members an expression names — `$currentObject/NoSuchAttr` passed too.
fix: checkExprSystemMembers in the attribute-scope walk (it has the data context): a `$currentObject/<name>` naming a declared pseudo-type attribute (any name, from the script's declaration), or one of describe's four names on a stored entity without such an attribute, is an error naming the expression spelling.
insight: Measured on 11.12.6 with one container per spelling: declared names (ChangedDate, CreatedDate, Owner, ChangedBy) are CE0117; changedDate, createdDate, System.owner, System.changedBy build — the user members are associations and need System. in an expression. General member checking of page expressions is still absent (the NoSuchAttr control) and is the bigger gap.
test: mdl/executor/validate_expr_system_member_2253_test.go TestExprSystemMemberSpelling (controls: the system spellings, an ordinary attribute, a real attribute named ChangedDate)
